hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$root='c:/Users/ccocu/Desktop/TRAVELLINIWITHUS'; Write-Host '--- TRAVELLINIWITHUS session health check ---'; try { $port = (Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://localhost:3000' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 1 -ErrorAction Stop).StatusCode; Write-Host "dev server: localhost:3000 reachable ($port)" } catch { Write-Host 'dev server: not running (run: npm run dev)' }; if (Test-Path "$root/.git") { $branch = git -C $root rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD; $dirty = (git -C $root status --porcelain | Measure-Object -Line).Lines; Write-Host "branch: $branch | dirty files: $dirty" }; if (Test-Path "$root/.env") { Write-Host '.env: present' } else { Write-Host '.env: MISSING' }; Write-Host '---'"

powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command '$cmd = $env:CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT; if ($cmd -match "rm\s+-rf|git\s+push\s+--force|git\s+reset\s+--hard|git\s+clean\s+-f|DROP\s+TABLE|firebase\s+deploy\s+--project\s+prod") { Write-Error "BLOCKED / BLOCCATO: Risky command detected. Ask owner before proceeding. Comando pericoloso rilevato. Chiedi conferma al proprietario prima di procedere."; exit 2 }'

powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command '$file = $env:CLAUDE_FILE_PATH; if ($file -match "server\.ts$|firestore\.rules$|src[\\/]config[\\/]admin\.ts$") { Write-Warning "HIGH-RISK FILE / FILE AD ALTO RISCHIO: $file. Double-check the change before continuing. Verifica attentamente le modifiche prima di procedere." }'
